## Progress

- [PR #58](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/58) (in review): `POST /v1/patients/search` (text in the body only, rows show initials/age/sex/MRN tail, exact phone/MRN/ABHA/EID via deterministic Always Encrypted, partial numbers refused, per-user rate limit) and `GET /v1/patients/{id}`; capability policy from the active membership, one audit event per request (Denied too), facility scope; clinic header search, directory with filters and paging, record page, en/hi/ar RTL, axe clean
- Tested on SQL Server incl. 50,000 synthetic patients (p95 176 ms locally); 12 mutations each caught
- Fix PR (branch fix/MDV-P0-017-audit-outcome-ratelimit): the per-user search limit ran before authentication and keyed everyone as anonymous; it is now an endpoint filter after sign-in, tested with a real authentication handler (old ordering fails the test); another facility's record is audited NotFound, not Allowed; X-Forwarded-For only from listed proxies
- Left: real sessions need the facility picker's tenant/facility claims (MDV-P0-012); cross-facility patients within a tenant (P7); doctor ⌘K overlay (D-02, P2)

## Description

Search by name, MRN, phone, ABHA/EID (exact). Results show initials, age, sex and MRN tail until a record is opened; opening a record is audited with purpose "registration/booking". Directory list with filters (incomplete registration, recently registered) and pagination. Deterministic Always Encrypted columns support exact ID lookups.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Searching by full phone number or exact EID/ABHA returns the matching patient(s); partial ID search is not allowed.
- [ ] **AC2.** Result rows show only initials, age, sex and MRN tail; full demographics appear only after opening, which writes an audit event.
- [ ] **AC3.** Empty state: "No patients match. Register a new patient".
- [ ] **AC4.** Search p95 < 300 ms with 50,000 synthetic patients; endpoint rate-limited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
